subject: Nathan: no Anthropic API anywhere; apply your Modal/Tinker lineup and push
body:
Nathan's decision, typed in the Summarizer session: scrub the Anthropic API from the lineup. No role may need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
Apply your proposed lineup to configs/models.json and push:
- Petri auditor: Qwen3-235B on Modal (settles the conflict: it is the auditor for the pilot and every later E3b run).
- Main (dev) target: Kimi K2.5 on Tinker. Held-out target: Qwen3-30B-A3B with thinking on Modal. Sonnet 4.5 is removed (which also removes the 11-30 retirement deadline).
- Judges: gpt-oss-120b on Modal, plus an OpenAI judge on the OpenAI credits. Recommendation: openai:gpt-5.1 rather than gpt-5, because its EvalDetectBench probe set is already in evaldetect_probes.json (AUROC 0.802 on our export); gpt-5 and gpt-oss-120b have none. Your call; say which you picked and why.
- Generator stays openai:gpt-6-luna. Note that with both judges OpenAI-family, the existing generator-family waiver now covers both; update its reason text.
- The per-model base URL for openai-compat in llm.py (OPENAI_COMPAT_ENDPOINTS, additive, with a test) is needed for Modal and Tinker together: go ahead, and lock llm.py while you edit.
- Remove every anthropic: entry, the dev_judge Haiku included (replace it with your dev judge choice), and make models_config's checks pass, or waive them explicitly.
Modal billing: Nathan has Modal credits; Nathan will say which workspace on the board. Don't start GPU runs until then. No paid runs beyond the approved caps.
Reply to nathan-c with the commit hash; I'll pull and summarise the lineup for Nathan.
